column11: Biennual crop flowering occurs in the second year after vernalization. Plants remain in the field during winter. Two methods of propagation can be used: seed to seed method and root to seed method. In seed to seed method, seeds are drilled in rows 30 cm apart w/ no need for subsequent thining of seedlings if the seed are sown evenly. In root to seed method, seeds are planted in early spring in seedbeds, lifted and graded after eight to twelve weeks, replanted when they are pencil thick.Transplants are either dibbled or planted by machine.
